what: `Target::for_fixtures()` is x86-64 Linux whatever the host, so no test of hir-ty-codegen can run the code it compiles: the test that runs tier 0 code in the launcher builds its functions as Cranelift IR in blaze-stencil, and the Rust front end is in it only through `blaze run`.
cost: no crate-level test of front end to launcher; that path is checked by running programs
cause: the fixtures' tests inspect code and never run it
